original_test_intent: Demonstrate Advanced-RAS bank-level ADDDC sparing with plus1 enabled on the approved x4 topology, including a passing harasser, correct bank/slot attribution, no fault lights and continued health.
original_method: A qualified operator installs the DIMMs and an FAE resolves bank mode, plus1 and target parameters. One bounded harasser is run; bank topology, transcript, event attribution, indicators and health are correlated before restoring the platform.
manual_activity: The operator performs DIMM service, Advanced-RAS bank/plus1 setup, harasser execution and LED observation; the agent verifies captured mapping and analyzes evidence.
required_inputs: PASSED, bank/slot corrected event, lights-off and health oracle
safety_requirements: ESD-safe operator and powered-down DIMM changes
Verify bank topology and plus1 pre-state
Run one approved self-checking bank-plus1 recipe
Abort on wrong bank/mode, UCE, failed harasser, light assertion or instability
No retry; restore and verify memory health
agent_execution_scope: Validate bank/plus1 captures and collect read-only transcript, Windows, BMC, UEFI and health evidence
Do not service hardware, set RAS/plus1, choose targets, inject/retry or judge outcome
engineer_actions: Define sparing success and correctable attribution

command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Advanced RAS Bank with plus1, x4 64 GB DIMMs, adjacent=True, debug=False, skipSelfCheck=False and 30/30 minutes are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture bank topology and plus1 state, run one resolved harasser, correlate PASSED and bank/slot events with health and off indicators, then restore/diff state.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The common Procedure has no explicit bank-mode or plus1 value and all harasser inputs remain variables. Physical population/coverage, Windows evidence and deterministic normal-operation/optional-UEFI criteria are missing.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The bank-plus1 purpose is identifiable and the missing recipe/map are obtainable FAE inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 27 Wistron-System RAS-00747-V003: approve 64 GB x4 DIMM slot/bank topology and Advanced-RAS bank-plus1 BIOS settings; ITP/CScripts version/hash and exact DeviceSparingHarasser runTime/adddc/adddcType/plus1-enabled/socket/mc/ch/bank coverage; define PASSED, bank/slot correctable events, indicators-off, Windows health, recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Makes bank-plus1 the auditable differentiator and prevents adjacent rank or no-plus1 evidence from masking missing coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: This row is valuable only if both bank granularity and plus1 are proven. Neither attribute appears as a resolved source parameter, so a log showing a corrected DIMM event cannot identify the tested branch. An FAE must bind adddcType, plus1 and topology to the package interface. The operator-owned stimulus plus agent-verifiable evidence forms a gated hybrid case, and the unresolved mode selection is a source conflict rather than a reason to guess or declare failure.
